name: Chat Thread Rep
description: A Replika conversation playing out bubble by bubble, with typing dots timed to each reply's word count. Renders 9:16 (1080x1920) with a transparent background. Text renders in DM Sans, a metric-matched stand-in for the licensed Pangea Text.

params.label: Conversation
params.default:
received: hey! how did it go?
sent: better than I expected
received: I knew it would
params.description: One message per line ("|" also separates, for paths that drop newlines). Prefix each with "received:" or "sent:", or the short "r:" / "s:" - unprefixed lines alternate, starting with received. Doubling the colon escapes it: "sent:: hi" is a message reading "sent: hi". Blank lines are ignored, and a message wrapped entirely in *asterisks* is a roleplay action rendered italic. Typing dots are inserted automatically before every received message, timed from its word count - not a parameter.

params.label: Duration (s)
params.description: Whole-thread length. The pauses, typing beats and the end hold stretch or compress to fit; each bubble's 240ms entrance does not, since the source is explicit that a slower arrival reads as broken. Set it below the sum of those fixed entrances and the clip overruns rather than rushing them.
